documents.summary: The CTE's seven guiding principles for AI in teaching ask faculty to state AI rules in their syllabi, be open about their own AI use, verify AI output, protect student data and build AI literacy instead of policing use. It sets no university-wide student rule and leaves the decision to each instructor.
